description: This bar chart, from the paper "Mapping the Minds of LLMs: A Graph-Based Analysis of Reasoning LLM," illustrates the proportion of incorrect responses, denoted as γc, across different numbers of shots (0 to 4) for two categories, as indicated by the legend: blue bars with a dotted pattern represent "Incorrect" responses, while magenta bars with diagonal hatching represent a second category, which is labeled "Incorrect" in the legend but visually distinct from the blue bars. The horizontal axis, labeled "Number of Shots," displays integer values from 0 to 4, representing the number of examples provided to the model. The vertical axis, labeled "γc," is scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.6, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. For each number of shots, there are two bars: the blue "Incorrect" bar is consistently shorter than the magenta bar. The blue bars have approximate values of 0.23 at 0 shots, 0.21 at 1 shot, 0.06 at 2 shots, 0.06 at 3 shots, and 0.06 at 4 shots. The magenta bars are significantly taller, with approximate values of 0.61 at 0 shots, 0.61 at 1 shot, 0.56 at 2 shots, 0.54 at 3 shots, and 0.27 at 4 shots. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each shot count, with the blue "Incorrect" bar appearing to the left of the magenta bar. The chart does not show any sorting of the bars by height, and no bars are visually emphasized with special formatting beyond the standard color and pattern coding.
